reasons: internal/api/mcp.go:60-67 mcpRefusal.Cause is never logged: when errors.As matches a refusal the branch only copies refusal.Message and skips logRequestError, so the underlying go-oidc verify error (which of signature/issuer/expiry/nbf failed) is dropped. internal/api/mcpoauth.go:173-174 promises "The cause stays in the log; the message goes to the client" and docs/ADMIN_GUIDE.md refusal table row `SSO access token is not valid …` tells operators "서버 로그에 세부 원인이 남습니다" — neither is true. The operator-facing message deliberately collapses four causes into one, so with no log entry there is no way to troubleshoot a rejected token; the auth feature's documented diagnosability is not implemented and no test covers it.
notes: Verified: go build/vet pass; all Go tests pass including the 6 PostgreSQL-backed MCP OAuth tests run against a throwaway postgres:16 container; web tsc --noEmit and the new vitest file pass.

Tests are substantive: fakeIdP signs real RS256 tokens, HS256 downgrade, forged issuer, expired/nbf, ID token, cnf, audience mismatch, account-not-created and REST-refusal cases all exercise the real /mcp handler and would fail without the new code.

mcpoauth.go:116-147 consults oidc.issuer but not oidc.enabled: disabling web OIDC login while leaving the issuer stored keeps MCP SSO tokens accepted. Documented as issuer-only, so consistent with the docs, but an admin who turns OIDC off to cut Keycloak trust may not expect /mcp to keep trusting it.

mcpoauth.go:93-98 MetadataURL: when mcp.oauth.resource is set without a /mcp suffix (validation allows any absolute URL) the challenge points at <public_url>/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp rather than the RFC 9728 path for that resource; only matters for an unusual configuration.

Principal.Can / requireRole switched from `AuthType != "api_key"` to `AuthType == "session"`; all Principal constructors set AuthType (session/api_key/oauth), so no existing path loses the admin bypass.

cache.go WithoutCancel also changes the existing web OIDC login provider creation; it is a correct fix (go-oidc RemoteKeySet fetches JWKS with its creation context) and values like the HTTP client survive WithoutCancel.
docs/ADMIN_GUIDE.pdf binary regenerated — matches the repo's established pattern (previous feature commits also rebuilt it).
Feature is off by default and only touches /mcp; revert is a plain code revert (new `mcp` setting row is inert once the code is gone).
